text: This method of the diffusers has a fragrant fowl, and a favorite, aromatic, tabberid tails the bark tatles much fronger than any other parts, and the final twige fringer than the large area. If the warm agentes and corroborate, and frequently employed with good fucsels for purifying and foreseeing the blood and juices. For their purpose, inflation made from the simplest nor or hair may be drank as tea. In forms conditions indeed, fish humans are by their fragments, app, on field taking them, to all the the herd, but in such cafes, they may be advantageously freed from their flavor by boiling. A detection of fallafras, boiled down to the confluence of an extract, proves firmly bitterth and fubaltingent. Hoffman affures us, that he has frequently given this extract to the quantity of a temple a time, with remarkable facets, for strengthening the tone of the vificera in ca-cherts; is allo in the decline of constituent levels, and in hypothetical fusions. Stifafras yields in di-filtration an extremely fragrant oil of a penetrating pungent tafes, foodcords (postwithstanding lightened to the deep yield) as to find in water. Rec-tified spirit extracts the whole tate and fowl of falls-fres, and cleaves nothing in separation, hence the spiritual extracts proves the most elegant and efficacious preparation, as containing the virtue of the root entire.
